summary: Tested the per-listing OG share feature end-to-end: backend /api/p/{id} OG HTML endpoint, /api/sitemap-listings.xml, robots.txt, frontend /listing/:id public page (PublicListing.jsx), Explore card → /listing/:id navigation, and key regression pages. All 9 pytest cases pass and all frontend UI assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >2300 lines — should be split into routers/modules (listings, orders, social, analytics). Flagged in previous iterations; still applies.
The OG image fallback is a hardcoded Unsplash URL inside share_listing (line 2094). Works fine, but consider moving to a constant/env for future branding changes.
PublicListing.jsx uses API_BASE to build shareUrl — good. However the 'Share URL' chip at the bottom (line 277) exposes the share URL visually; acceptable but may be removed for cleaner UX.

Seed data mismatch (cosmetic, flagged by user as known): first listing 'Cocoa' has country_code=NG but currency=GHS, so country chip shows '🇳🇬 Nigeria' while price shows 'GH₵45/kg'. User explicitly said not to flag — noted only for context.
test_credentials: Buyer: buyer@agriflow.ng / Buyer@123 (not actually needed — /listing/:id is public)
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded listings from GET /api/listings (first listing id auto-detected: Cocoa c3823fd5-062a-4386-b831-45c80779d544).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for OG share lives in /app/backend/tests/test_social_share.py. It auto-picks an active listing id at runtime. Coverage: OG tags, og:url uses PUBLIC_SITE_URL, JSON-LD Product, meta refresh + window.location.replace redirects, 404 for non-existent listing, sitemap XML content-type + <loc> entries, robots.txt references both sitemaps. Frontend /listing/:id tested via Playwright: country chip, crop title, price, signup CTA with ref=listing-{id}, login CTA with next=..., escrow notice, dynamic doc title, share button toggling to 'Link copied' via clipboard fallback (navigator.share deleted in-test), invalid id → /explore redirect, regression on /, /login, /signup.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All features work as specified.
verified_features: GET /api/p/{valid_id} → 200 HTML with all required OG meta (og:type=product, og:site_name=AGRIOS, og:title incl. crop+price, og:description, og:url with PUBLIC_SITE_URL, og:image, 1200x630, twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:title, twitter:image, product:price:amount & currency)
JSON-LD Product parseable (schema.org/Product with offers.priceCurrency + offers.price)
meta http-equiv=refresh + window.location.replace both present pointing to /listing/{id}

/listing/:id renders country flag chip, crop title, price, farmer name, escrow notice, signup CTA /signup?ref=listing-{id}, login CTA /login?next=/app/marketplace/{id}, share button (data-testid=share-listing-btn)
document.title updates to include crop once listing loads (e.g., 'Cocoa · GH₵45/kg · AGRIOS')
Share button click (with navigator.share stubbed out) copies to clipboard and button text toggles to 'Link copied'
